framework_reasoning: Router::fallback at routing/mod.rs registers a MethodRouter(any(handler)). PathRouter selects that MethodRouter and call_with_state returns its RouteFuture.

RouteFuture::new defaults top_level=true. Its poll sets content length before replacing a HEAD response body with Body::empty(), including handler fallback responses. The locally inspected four routing files exactly match the Cargo.lock-checksummed registry archive.

Console platform_list_transport only selects exact orgs/ops/groups GET/HEAD paths. Trailing-slash Group HEAD goes directly to next.run, so framework body normalization is not a wrapper-selection defect.

The old assertion wrongly required nonempty fixture bytes for every unselected method. The successor fixes only HEAD expectations, still requires literal fixture bytes for all other methods, and adds identical-request unwrapped status/header/body controls.

Wrongly selecting an unselected path still fails original cache/ETag/Vary checks or complete HeaderMap equality; corrupting non-HEAD body/status or any other header still fails fixed expectations/full equality.
Selected strict private/no-store/Authorization-Vary/no-validator and selected HEAD-body behavior are unchanged byte-for-byte, as are all four missing-credential Group cases.
failure_evidence_limit: Prior root failure log identifies only the combined assertion, not its method/path. Pinned framework source establishes the HEAD expectation error; the exact failing dynamic matrix case and corrected runtime result remain unobserved by this reviewer.
